trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: I wish I saved more when I was young.
trap.right: I wish I had saved more when I was young.
trap.why: Em português “queria ter economizado”, o brasileiro usa o passado simples. Para arrependimento use wish + had + particípio.

opts: I wish I will call her.
I wish I had called her.

fix.wrong: I wish I chose another job.
fix.right: I wish I had chosen another job.

fix.wrong: I wish I would have studied.

rewrite.answer: I wish I had called her.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “We spent too much.” (We wish… not)
rewrite.answer: We wish we hadn’t spent so much.
